kāsiya.p: [Kāsi+iya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Kāsī country. (Ti) (2) One who lives in Kāsī country. (Kāsī people). (3) The clothes that are made of Kāsī country. (4) (The woolen goods) that is worthy of one thousand.
